summary: WIZE (1340 AM, branded WIZE AM 1340) is a commercial radio station in Springfield, Ohio, owned by iHeartMedia, Inc. as part of its Dayton cluster. The station broadcasts a classic country format aimed at Springfield listeners. Its transmitter and former studios are also located in Springfield.
